name: efight_panel
_comment: E-fight wave 4: efight_formation, but before every shot `r` targets the nearest hostile, so the target panel shows a raider's shield/armor. The player never fires (Kit Tickler only, never triggered): any damage on the raiders is the escorts'. Pilots w4_efix (fixed guns, shïp 769), w4_erear (rear turrets, 770), w3_efight (full turrets, 764, the control).
